description: NaBi₅O₈ crystallizes in the monoclinic Pc space group. The structure is two-dimensional and consists of one NaBi₅O₈ sheet oriented in the (np.int64(1), np.int64(0), np.int64(0)) direction. There are two inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to three O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.26-2.45 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a distorted pentagonal planar geometry to five O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.47-2.70 Å. There are ten inequivalent Bi sites. In the first Bi site, Bi is bonded in a rectangular see-saw-like geometry to four O atoms. There are a spread of Bi-O bond distances ranging from 2.14-2.66 Å. In the second Bi site, Bi is bonded to five O atoms to form edge-sharing BiO₅ square pyramids. There are a spread of Bi-O bond distances ranging from 2.18-2.48 Å. In the third Bi site, Bi is bonded to five O atoms to form distorted edge-sharing BiO₅ square pyramids. There are a spread of Bi-O bond distances ranging from 2.11-2.59 Å. In the fourth Bi site, Bi is bonded to five O atoms to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing BiO₅ square pyramids. There are a spread of Bi-O bond distances ranging from 2.19-2.50 Å. In the fifth Bi site, Bi is bonded in a distorted T-shaped geometry to three O atoms. There are a spread of Bi-O bond distances ranging from 2.13-2.17 Å. In the sixth Bi site, Bi is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to five O atoms. There are a spread of Bi-O bond distances ranging from 2.20-2.72 Å. In the seventh Bi site, Bi is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to four O atoms. There are a spread of Bi-O bond distances ranging from 2.15-2.52 Å. In the eighth Bi site, Bi is bonded in a distorted rectangular see-saw-like geometry to four O atoms. There are a spread of Bi-O bond distances ranging from 2.16-2.42 Å. In the ninth Bi site, Bi is bonded to five O atoms to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing BiO₅ square pyramids. There are a spread of Bi-O bond distances ranging from 2.18-2.70 Å. In the tenth Bi site, Bi is bonded to five O atoms to form distorted edge-sharing BiO₅ square pyramids. There are a spread of Bi-O bond distances ranging from 2.17-2.57 Å. There are sixteen inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a trigonal non-coplanar geometry to one Na and two Bi atoms. In the second O site, O is bonded to four Bi atoms to form distorted OBi₄ tetrahedra that share  a cornercorner with one ONaBi₃ tetrahedra and  an edgeedge with one OBi₄ tetrahedra. In the third O site, O is bonded to four Bi atoms to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing OBi₄ tetrahedra. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a trigonal non-coplanar geometry to one Na and two Bi atoms. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal non-coplanar geometry to one Na and two Bi atoms. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a distorted T-shaped geometry to three Bi atoms. In the seventh O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to three Bi atoms. In the eighth O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal planar geometry to one Na and two Bi atoms. In the ninth O site, O is bonded to one Na and three Bi atoms to form a mixture of corner and edge-sharing ONaBi₃ tetrahedra. In the tenth O site, O is bonded to four Bi atoms to form distorted OBi₄ trigonal pyramids that share  a cornercorner with one OBi₄ tetrahedra and  an edgeedge with one ONaBi₃ tetrahedra. In the eleventh O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na and two Bi atoms. In the twelfth O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal planar geometry to three Bi atoms. In the thirteenth O site, O is bonded in a trigonal non-coplanar geometry to three Bi atoms. In the fourteenth O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal non-coplanar geometry to three Bi atoms. In the fifteenth O site, O is bonded in a distorted rectangular see-saw-like geometry to one Na and three Bi atoms. In the sixteenth O site, O is bonded in a distorted T-shaped geometry to one Na and two Bi atoms.
